name: Default
shortDescription: Web app to store your two-factor authentication accounts and generate their TOTP, HOTP and Steam Guard codes, backed by SQLite.

alerts.message: The first account registered becomes the administrator. Create it right after deployment, then disable registration in Admin > App Setup if nobody else should sign up.
Data is encrypted with the generated APP_KEY. Keep it: if it is lost or changed, encrypted data cannot be recovered.
